questions.q: Statements: All roses are flowers. No flowers are plants. Conclusions: I. All roses are plants. II. Some plants are roses.
questions.why: Checked against every possible diagram of the statements: I need not be true, II need not be true. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: What comes next in the series? 5, 2, 7, 9, 16, …
questions.why: Each term is the sum of the two before it. Next: 25. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: In a group of 60 people, 34 like Konkani, 36 like Marathi and 3 like neither. How many like only Konkani?
questions.why: Both = 34 + 36 − (60 − 3) = 13; only Konkani = 34 − 13 = 21. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Three partners shared profit in the ratio 5 : 7 : 8, having invested for 14, 8 and 7 months. What was the ratio of their investments?
questions.why: Investment ∝ profit ÷ time: 5/14 : 7/8 : 8/7, × 56 = 20 : 49 : 64. GPSC JSO pre-screening, Jun 2026.

questions.q: In an artificial language, migenlasan means cupboard, lasanpoen means boardwalk and cuopdansa means pullman. Which word could mean "walkway"?
questions.why: lasan = board, so poen = walk; the word must start with poen and not use migen (cup). GPSC CBRT, Mar 2025.

questions.q: Two trains run in opposite directions with speeds 2 : 1. The first passes a standing man in 5 s, the second in 8 s. How long do they take to cross each other?
questions.why: Lengths 10v and 8v; relative speed 3v; 18v ÷ 3v = 6 s. GPSC CBRT, Feb 2024.

questions.q: What is the angle between the hands of a clock at 9:40?
What comes next in the series? 7, 26, 63, 124, 215, …
questions.why: n³ − 1 for n = 2, 3, …. Next: 342. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Concert ticket prices for VIP, Executive and Economy are in the ratio 5 : 3 : 2. In a sale, VIP gets 20% off and Executive 10% off; Economy has no discount. If an Executive ticket costs ₹2,700 after discount, what is the combined cost of one ticket of each category in the sale?
questions.why: Executive full price 3000, so 1 part = 1000. 4000 + 2700 + 2000 = 8700. GPSC JSO pre-screening, Jun 2026.
